title: Zesty Egyptian Turkey Neck Skewers
description: A pungent and crunchy Egyptian dish featuring turkey neck, deep-fried to perfection, served on a comal, perfect for a hangover cure. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional Egyptian cuisine.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the turkey neck pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat, cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the turkey neck pieces from the marinade, allowing any excess to drip off.
Deep-fry the turkey neck pieces in batches until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes per batch.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried turkey neck pieces from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Thread the fried turkey neck pieces onto skewers, if desired.
Serve the Zesty Egyptian Turkey Neck Skewers on a comal, garnished with lemon wedges and parsley.
